_about: BACKLOG 82.3, D7 — every comma split under src/. A list of SELECTORS or COLLECTION NAMES supplied by a caller is split in ONE place, src/selector.ts, which strips ASCII padding only and refuses an element that starts with a byte-order mark. Every other split is listed here with what it splits. tests/unit/list-splits-census.test.ts fails on a split this file does not list, and on a listed one that is gone.

splits.why: --runs: directories of evaluation runs, resolved as filesystem paths

splits.code: const ids = raw === "held" ? null : raw.split(",").map(x => Number(x.trim()));
splits.why: --retry-now: range ids, each parsed as an integer and checked
--pair-require-ids: case ids of an evaluation set
CLAWMEM_HEARTBEAT_PATTERNS: substrings to match in a prompt, lower-cased — not names of stored things
the brace list of a collection PATTERN from the config file — a glob, not a stored name
THE parser of caller-supplied selector and collection lists (trimAsciiSpace, then the refusal)
a serve allowlist from the environment (hosts, origins); an empty entry is refused
a day list that SQLite's group_concat built from stored dates — not caller input
